item.title: More Kennedy Center Concerts Canceled Over Trump Renaming
item.description: A couple of weeks ago, White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt announced that Washington, DC's Kennedy Center would change its name to the Trump-Kennedy Center. Jazz musician Chuck Redd responded by canceling his annual Christmas Eve concert at the venue, and venue president Richard Grenell threatened Redd with a million-dollar lawsuit. But the potential of a lawsuit hasn't stopped more artists from canceling their planned Kennedy Center performances in protest. The post More Kennedy Center

item.title: Amyl And The Sniffers Singer Sues Photographer For Exploiting Magazine Shoot
item.description: Amy Taylor, leader of the Australian punk band Amyl And The Sniffers, is suing photographer Jamie Nelson in a California district court, accusing the photographer of "exploitation of her image." According to the complaint, Nelson did a photo shoot with Taylor for Vogue Portugal with the understanding that Nelson would not sell the images from that shoot as fine art prints. item.title: Jennifer Lopez Covers Lana Del Rey At Vegas Residency Opener
item.description: Last year, amid personal upheaval and low ticket sales, Jennifer Lopez rebranded and then canceled an entire arena tour. But if you really want to go see JLo sing her hits, you now have an opportunity. On Tuesday night, Lopez kicked off her latest Las Vegas residency, which is called Up All Night Live and which is happening at the Caesar's Palace Colosseum. item.title: Post Malone Livestreams Painful Backflip Attempt, Teases Two New Albums For 2026
item.description: In career terms, Post Malone is awfully agile.
